value.description: The Protobuf message, serialized as bytes and base64-encoded. The specific message type is identified by the `type` field.

The reference over the overlap: the sessions of the window where the same-data reference exists. The
 reference fields above are measured over that overlap, which ends at reference_to. A paper-track tail after
 the run's last session carries no reference, so the window's own figures stop there. The last session the reference is measured to; "" when there is no reference. (proto string)
referenceTo.title: reference_to

sharpeSe.description: Lo (2002) standard error of the annual Sharpe ratio. (proto double)
sharpeSe.title: sharpe_se

strategyOverlapCagrPct.title: strategy_overlap_cagr_pct

strategyOverlapTotalReturnPct.description: The strategy's total return over the same overlap, for a like-for-like comparison. (proto double)
strategyOverlapTotalReturnPct.title: strategy_overlap_total_return_pct

bearerAuth.description: Required. A signed-in method takes a Shorted API token (minted at https://shorted.com.au/account) or a Firebase ID token; an admin method takes an administrator's Firebase ID token (a verified address on the admin allowlist), or the web tier's internal secret asserting the admin role. A missing or wrong credential is unauthenticated; the right credential without the role is permission_denied.

info.description: The Connect-RPC methods of api.shorted.com.au that need a credential: a signed-in user's (any account) or an administrator's. Not published; generated for the admin console. The public methods are documented at https://shorted.com.au/docs/api.
info.title: Shorted private API

post.description: Create a premium short-interest alert monitor for the current user.
Delete one of the current user's monitors and its event history.
Recent alert events (monitors that fired) for the current user, newest report first.
List short-interest alert monitors for the current user.
Pause or resume one of the current user's monitors. Resuming requires Premium.
Get the current user's subscription status. Requires authentication.
Mint an API token for the user. Requires valid authentication.

Trigger enrichment for a specific stock. Admin only.
 Returns enrichment data for review before applying to company-metadata.

Get a specific pending enrichment by ID. Admin only.
Get top stocks for enrichment batching/prioritization. Admin only.
List enrichment jobs with optional status filter. Admin only.
List pending enrichments awaiting review. Admin only.
Approve or reject a pending enrichment. Admin only.
Trigger key metrics sync for specific stocks. Admin only.
Get sync status for admin dashboard
Admin: hard delete a take.
Admin: list all takes including drafts (admin-gated).

Admin: list takes in the tweet publish queue (published_at IS NOT NULL,
 tweet_published_at IS NULL). Used by the bot worker.

Admin: publish a draft take (sets published_at = NOW()).
Admin: partial update of a take's editable fields.

Two or three canonical strategies over their common window: windows, rebased weekly curves,
 daily-return correlations and the rule differences. Signed-in callers only. Variant references
 are refused until variant comparison ships.

The same ranked picks as GetStrategyPicks, at the caller's full depth. It
 needs a signed-in caller (a bearer token, or the web's session) and is never
 clamped: the viewer field reports access "free" or "premium" and clamped
 false.

The trades of one canonical run, keyset-paged and filterable by stock and exit reason. Signed-in
 callers only. A variant, gate-refused or unknown run is NotFound.

The caller's saved strategies, most recent first, each with today's
 status counts.

The status changes of one strategy's canonical rules version, newest first:
 a stock entering or leaving a status, with the rule results that day.

Save a strategy to the signed-in caller's list. Saving a strategy that is
 already saved succeeds and keeps its first save time. The list holds at
 most 20; a save past that is refused with PermissionDenied and the
 X-Entitlement-Detail metadata (capability cap_reached, with the limit), and
 a repeat save at the cap still succeeds.

Remove a strategy from the caller's list. Removing one that is not saved
 succeeds.

rejection.X-RateLimit-Access: api or browser — paid browser access is unlimited, paid API access is not
rejection.X-RateLimit-Bucket: Edge rejections only: the traffic class that rejected
rejection.X-RateLimit-Detail: Compact JSON mirroring all of the above: kind, limit, used, remaining, reset_at, retry_after_seconds, tier, access, upgrade_url, message
rejection.X-RateLimit-Kind: Which limit fired: per_minute or monthly
rejection.X-RateLimit-Scope: Edge rejections only: edge-10s or edge-60s
rejection.X-RateLimit-Upgrade-Url: Absolute URL to raise the limit

success.X-RateLimit-Monthly-Reset: Unix seconds at the start of next month
success.X-RateLimit-Remaining: Requests left in the current minute
success.X-RateLimit-Reset: Unix seconds when the minute window resets
